description.value:
Choose forcecasting or techcasting. You gain a +1 bonus to the save DC and attack modifier for your chosen casting type.

Once per turn, when you cast a power of that type requiring an attack roll or a saving throw, you can grant advantage on one attack roll you make with it, or force one affected creature to have advantage or disadvantage (your choice) on its save; each option can only be used once per power until you finish a short or long rest, and once per creature until you finish a short or long rest.

Once per turn, when you cast a power of that type that requires a die roll but no ability check, attack roll, or saving throw, you can set the result of that die to its maximum or minimum; if multiple dice are rolled, you may affect a number of them up to half your proficiency bonus (rounded up), and each power can only be affected this way once until you finish a short or long rest.

You can take this feat twice, choosing the other casting type the second time.

system.requirements: 4th level, the ability to cast force or tech powers.
